rg -n 'catalog|ReferenceSource|HostBridge|HostEffect' crates/editor-api/src/lib.rs classic/rust/editor-runtime-wasm/src/lib.rs | head -100
sed -n '100,165p' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_insert.rs
sed -n '1,240p' crates/editor-api/src/artifact.rs
rg -n 'automationEdits|enqueueScene|runFullAutoEdit|runSceneAction|runStandalone' classic/apps/web/src/ai -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' | head -90

cat crates/editor-api/src/editor_render.rs
rg -n 'editorRender|hyperframesReferences|automation|sound-effects' classic/apps/web/src -g '*host*.ts' -g '*agent*.ts' -g '*bridge*.ts' | head -150
rg -n 'project.classic.automation.edit|"sound-effects"|action.*WordAnimation|Action::SoundEffects' crates/editor-api/tests crates/editor-api/src classic/rust/editor-runtime-wasm/src -g '*.rs' | head -75
